active.description: Indicates whether the custom ticket status is active.

agent_label.description: Label shown to agents for this ticket status.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the custom ticket status was created.

default.description: Indicates if this is the default ticket status.

description.description: Description of the custom ticket status for agents.

end_user_description.description: Description of the ticket status shown to end users.

end_user_label.description: Label shown to end users for this ticket status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the custom ticket status.

raw_agent_label.description: Untranslated agent label for this ticket status.

raw_end_user_description.description: Untranslated description shown to end users.

status_category.description: Category of the ticket status (e.g., open, pending, solved).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the custom ticket status was last updated.
